searchText: The motivation is to store keys and VC in TEE so that the keys are secure. Tho if the client stores them un encrypted in RAM it is a useless excercise. one motivation would be to sign sidecars that sign something else together with the block, a-la eigenlayer. The TEE can enforce any other commitment before signing. ah ok, so not tee the app that logs to file? maybe i just mis-understood the q
